title: Performance configuration and redaction
behavioral_concerns: Dedicated performance model and variant obey documented workspace and environment precedence with safe fallback.
Effective operational limits remain inspectable without exposing secret-bearing model or environment values.
Every performance setting is typed, centrally loaded, source-attributed, and validated before use.
Redacted diagnostics conceal performance model and variant while retaining non-secret limit values and provenance.
Workspace and environment limits may lower defaults but cannot be zero, negative, malformed, non-finite, overflowed, or increased.

theories.claim: Performance-specific defaults and lower-only validation are implemented in the generic platform config package, violating the requirement that product defaults and bounded-context validation remain in the owning product module.
theories.basis: The platform file defines performance workflow defaults and lower-only policy validation, while the architecture contract forbids product-specific defaults and validation rules in platform packages (qa-v1-block-a42ba81ee3aabfa3bef7fe97, qa-v1-block-93319d60c8f44378e2d09a2c).

theories.refutation_condition: The performance limits are generic runtime infrastructure without product workflow semantics, or the owning product module exclusively defines the defaults and policy validation.
theories.inconclusive_condition: The package ownership boundary or applicability of ARCH-SHARED-001 cannot be determined from the supplied source and contract.

package config

import (
	"fmt"
	"go/ast"
	"go/parser"
	"go/token"
	"testing"
)

func TestQAInvestigator_a4e36afcbad1(t *testing.T) {
	declaredFunctions := func(t *testing.T, path string) map[string]bool {
		t.Helper()
		file, err := parser.ParseFile(token.NewFileSet(), path, nil, 0)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("parse %s: %v", path, err)
		}
		functions := make(map[string]bool)
		for _, declaration := range file.Decls {
			if function, ok := declaration.(*ast.FuncDecl); ok {
				functions[function.Name.Name] = true
			}
		}
		return functions
	}

	t.Run("control_generic_config_infrastructure_is_allowed", func(t *testing.T) {
		functions := declaredFunctions(t, "config.go")
		if !functions["Load"] {
			t.Fatal("control failed: generic config Load function was not found")
		}
	})

	functions := declaredFunctions(t, "performance.go")
	forbiddenPolicy := []string{"DefaultPerformance", "validatePerformance"}
	var found []string
	for _, name := range forbiddenPolicy {
		if functions[name] {
			found = append(found, name)
		}
	}
	if len(found) != 0 {
		fmt.Println("assertion: Assert the current source defines product-specific performance defaults and validation under internal/platform.")
		fmt.Println("ULTRAPLAN_QA_PREDICTED_FAILURE:TestQAInvestigator_a4e36afcbad1")
		t.Fail()
	}
}
